The procedure only re-sends a reversed credit if it is reported within 8 hours, so Finance moved the money to Morgan's Club Account balance instead. I asked Finance to pay it to the card anyway, citing the terms clause that refunds go to the purchase card. Finance replied with the same line both times: refund issued, no further payment due.
